title: R-204 certificate assertion-count correction revalidation
question: Does the current R-204 Gaussian Fourier uniform-heat package match its certificate assertion counts after the integrated lane changed from 23/23 to 24/24?
method: Compare the certificate assertion-count sentence with the current integrated verifier output.
Update only the stale integrated count and refresh the certificate SHA256 in the manifest.
Rerun primary, stdlib-only independent, and integrated lanes with --no-store and preserve the proxy owner boundary.
finding: The certificate had a stale bookkeeping value: it reported primary 45/45, independent 40/40, and integrated 23/23, while the current integrated verifier executes 24/24. The certificate was corrected to 24/24 and the manifest certificate hash was refreshed. Fresh reruns pass primary 45/45, independent 40/40, and integrated 24/24. The derived proxy majorant Q_N(s)<=529152 for s>=2 and every owner-boundary assertion are unchanged.
decision_reason: This is an append-only documentation correction, not a new theorem or gate closure. The integrated assertion-count increase reflects an existing verifier assertion and does not add a production heat-root map, filtration, raw-current intertwiner, or q-ledger.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing proxy theorem only. The diagonal-Gaussian comparison remains distinct from the nonlinear A1 production mobility, heat-root incidence, root filtration, conditional replicas, raw-current spatial intertwiner, once-owned q-ledger, OVERLAP_src, Nelson, interacting measure, physical-empty ordering, OS/KMS or real-time dynamics, removal, continuum, Sector-A, and Pre-A closure.
next_action: Retain R-204 as a comparison-only proxy. Do not rerun the R-192 production owner order until a hash-pinned A1 production mobility, heat_root_incidence, root-labelled filtration, raw-current spatial identity, and once-owned nonnegative q-ledger are supplied.
